current.text: Verify that all sensitive data protection levels have a documented set of protection requirements. This must include (but not be limited to) requirements related to general encryption, integrity verification, retention, how the data is to be logged, access controls around sensitive data in logs, database-level encryption, privacy and privacy-enhancing technologies to be used, and other confidentiality requirements.

predecessors.text: Verify that all protection levels have an associated set of protection requirements, such as encryption requirements, integrity requirements, retention, privacy and other confidentiality requirements, and that these are applied in the architecture.

Verify that sensitive or private information that is required to be encrypted, is encrypted using approved algorithms that provide both confidentiality and integrity. ([C8](https://owasp.org/www-project-proactive-controls/#div-numbering))

summaries.body:
V14.1.2 is carried from 4.0.3 V1.8.2 and also covers V8.3.7. The mapping records MODIFIED, MOVED FROM v4.0.3-1.8.2, COVERS v4.0.3-8.3.7. V1.8.2 required each protection level to have associated protection requirements (encryption, integrity, retention, privacy, other confidentiality) applied in the architecture. V8.3.7 required encrypting sensitive or private information with approved algorithms that provide confidentiality and integrity.

The current clause is the documentation half: each sensitive-data protection level must have documented requirements, now enumerating logging, log access control, database-level encryption, and privacy-enhancing technologies as well. Implementation of those documented controls was split to V14.2.4. Issue #504 (vanderaj, 2019-02-21) treated 4.0 V8.3.7 as overlapping a memory-wipe control and having the wrong CWE; that dispute is about the covered predecessor's identity, not the 5.0 documentation list. Git stamped V14.1.2 in 2021 (elar closes #880) is 4.x Configuration slot reuse.

The wording change that mattered is the 5.0 expansion of V1.8.2's architecture-applied protection requirements into an explicit documentation list (encryption, integrity, retention, logging, log access, database encryption, PETs, confidentiality), while V8.3.7's algorithm requirement is only "covered," not restated here. tghosth's C8 tag and minor tweaks on V8.3.7 (2019-02-24) are 4.0 tagging.

elar's 2021-03-18 V14.1.2 move (closes #880) is Configuration-chapter ID-slot work, not this documentation control.
